audit.why: Qiyana-favoured lane (53.18% WR, 613 games): Anivia is immobile with only a telegraphed Flash Frost; Qiyana dictates all seven stages, Anivia's threat is teamfights and scaling, which the page frames correctly.

Spikes: level 3 (all elements, dash past Q), level 6 (dive through egg beats Glacial Storm zone), first item (two-cycle the egg), late Anivia teamfight scaling. All four spikes[] entries present and kit-grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content: rows 4 and 6 said 'Anivia' while win[4]/win[6] and the packet chart say Qiyana, and rows 0-3/5 carried blanket 'Skill'. Cooldowns field had no digit. Twelve misgendered fields called Anivia he/his. Interactions themselves check out: Flash Frost (Q, 11s->7s) is her only hard CC and a blockable projectile; Frostbite (E, 4s) only doubles after Q or formed storm; Crystallize (W, 17s) can wall your W/E dash paths; egg passive means every kill is two health bars.
audit.why: Content and packet agree with each other, so the full sides are the stale layer; MC_IS_FEMALE lists anivia as she/her.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Qiyana with whys rewritten; real numbers (Q 11s rank 1, W 17s, R 120s) written into breakdown.cooldowns; pronouns corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes under unrelated titles.
